apps.name: Dispatcher
apps.description: Schedule outbound pickups and inbound arrivals, track load progress, and view daily timelines.
apps.releaseNotes:
Dispatcher 1.0.0

Schedule outbound pickups and inbound arrivals from your Android phone.

- Today shows outgoing loads with horizontal and vertical timelines.
- Inbounds and Outbounds open with the Today filter; search by load, PRO, carrier, or PO.
- Assign or reschedule pickup times with a scrolling date picker.
- Outgoing cards show the PRO number, carrier badge, shipment progress, and inspection shield.
- Smooth, centered pull-to-refresh preserves your search and timeline position.
- Sign in with your MES account; your username is remembered. Optionally unlock a saved session with phone security.
- Configure inbound and outbound status notices independently.

Android 9 or newer. MES account authorization is required. Saved sessions can expire and require your password again. Status notices work while Dispatcher is connected; closed-app push notifications are not included.

This is the first production release. It installs separately from the earlier debug review app.

apps.name: MES Store
apps.description: Your MES apps and updates, together in one place.
apps.releaseNotes:
MES Store 1.2.10

Distinct Featured cards for your workplace apps:
- Dispatcher has a charcoal-and-amber pickup timeline and truck illustration.
- Time Punch has a sage-and-green clock and employee punch illustration.
- SignPad keeps its signature artwork with updated messaging.
- MES Store is excluded from Featured and remains available under Apps.

- Dispatcher displays its actual launcher icon throughout the store, including before installation.
- The bottom navigation is more compact, leaving more room for app content.
- Download and installation buttons fill as progress bars and show measured percentages.
- Installation still requires Android confirmation, with cancellation, retry, and interrupted-session recovery.

Install over the existing MES Store to preserve settings and downloads. Android 9 or newer. The package ID and release signing key are unchanged.

apps.name: SignPad
apps.description: Sign bills of lading, scan shipments, and keep warehouse work moving.
apps.releaseNotes:
SignPad 1.6.2

Shipment confirmations use compact rows, clearer carrier badges, selection states, and action buttons. Loading confirmations show completed shipment progress from the updated MES server.

Install over the existing SignPad app to retain pairing and authorization. The package ID and signing certificate are unchanged. MES authorization is required to access company data.

apps.name: Time Punch
apps.description: Employee PIN, punch photos, and clock-in, break, and clock-out actions for MES tablets.
apps.releaseNotes:
Time Punch 1.1.2

The company name below the keypad now uses a light font weight with gray text. The portrait layout, circular front-camera preview, and punch workflow are unchanged.

Install over the existing Time Punch app to keep your station configuration.
